correctness.rationale: The full face complex has 17 vertices, 68 edges and 68 triangles with no four-clique. A specified determinant-one 52x52 submatrix of the integral triangle boundary, after deleting a verified spanning tree, proves H1=0 over Z and H2=Z^16. All 136 graph automorphisms were independently enumerated; signed face traces for all 136 match the vertex augmentation character. The integral cycle lattice basis from this unimodular minor yields a central-involution mod-2 (u-I) matrix of rank 8. The inclusions 2L subset L+ + L- subset ker(u-I mod2) and injection L/(L+ + L-) into L+/2L+ show precisely (Z/2)^8. All computations are replayable with standalone Python standard-library code in checks/check.py and its recorded stdout. The theorem is only about this exact finite graph and involution.

value.rationale: The exact graph P17 realizes the Ramsey R(4,4) lower bound and has a canonical 136-element symmetry group. Its topological H2 module matching the vertex augmentation representation gives a structural connection to the graph Fourier adjacency eigenspaces, not provided by the existing nonequivariant wedge calculation. The integral quotient (Z/2)^8 records the maximal nonsplitting of the two involution eigensublattices and is invisible to the Betti numbers and rational character. This is an exact natural integral invariant of a canonical symmetric combinatorial object, with independently replayable finite certificates; no unsupported general theorem is asserted.
